svg.title: Microsoft Foundry building blocks for the Cedar Dispatch Advisor
svg.desc: An Azure resource group rg-cedar-dev holds the Foundry resource cedar-ai-dev. The resource holds model deployments, for example cedar-chat, used by agents and as the evaluation judge. Inside the resource, the project cedar-agents holds the prompt agent cedar-dispatch-advisor with immutable versions 1, 2 and 3, a stable endpoint and its own Microsoft Entra agent identity; conversations and responses; datasets and evaluation runs; and connections to Application Insights appi-cedar-dev for traces and to Key Vault. Around it, people and identities with Azure roles: Dana holds Foundry Account Owner on the resource, for projects, model deployments and assigning Foundry User; Karim and the pipeline identity cedar-ci-dev hold Foundry User on the project and build agents; callers that only chat hold Foundry Agent Consumer at agent scope. Karim's Python host calls the project endpoint with DefaultAzureCredential and runs the function tools itself, reading Cedar facts with its own identity. A note says that a Copilot Studio agent lives in a Dataverse solution, while a Foundry agent lives in an Azure project and is recreated from its definition in Git in each project.
